name: UniFi MCP Server
description: Enables comprehensive management of UniFi Network infrastructure through 24 tools for monitoring and controlling devices, clients, wireless networks, security, and guest access. Supports network administration tasks like device restarts, client blocking, WLAN configuration, and backup creation.
